data_sources.terrain_maplibre: MapTiler/Mapterhorn raster DEM endpoint used by the official MapLibre terrain example
data_sources.terrain_cesium: Cesium World Terrain when an ion token is supplied
data_sources.buildings_maplibre: OpenStreetMap building footprints fetched through Overpass API
data_sources.buildings_cesium: Cesium OSM Buildings when an ion token is supplied

limitations: Building footprints and coordinates are real OSM data; facade textures are not included.
When OSM height and level tags are absent, the MapLibre fallback viewer uses a clearly marked category estimate.
Cesium OSM Buildings provides its own estimatedHeight for buildings without recorded height.
This stage validates network data coverage and visual alignment before ROS collision-map conversion.
